candidates.description: This vector represents words related to necessity, possibility, and importance across multiple languages.
This vector represents modal and auxiliary verbs expressing possibility, necessity, or ability across French and English.
First-person, second-person, and third-person personal pronouns in various languages.
This vector represents abstract mental constructs, ideas, and intellectual or philosophical subjects.
This vector represents concepts related to objects, subjects, and their associated linguistic roots and variations.
This feature vector represents psychological and philosophical states related to mind, morality, and inner disposition.
This feature activates on words and morphological variants related to existence, being, and related philosophical or linguistic roots.
These tokens function as common French adverbial modifiers and connectors that indicate frequency, emphasis, consequence, or logical relation.
Demonstrative determiners and pronouns in French.
These tokens represent French elided pronouns and articles attached to an apostrophe.
